verdict: Acceptable as an explicitly category-provided source development benchmark. Ready for the separately required input-only audit/code/generated/entry stages; this review does not execute or authorize forward.

implementation_clarifications.note: Interpret unique_forward_key concretely as original raw file SHA plus exact caption/token sequence (and asserted nativeHW). Decode verifies decoded uint8HWC SHA. The phrase decoded input RGB file SHA should not lead to dropping original file identity or accidentally reusing a result for another requested category.

Persist active-token position indices, full tokenizer input_ids/attention_mask, full raw active FP32 logits for every original model query, raw normalized boxes, output-axis lengths, kept original query ordinals, postprocessed native boxes/scores/text labels, and processor/tokenizer/code bindings. Persist a per-forward padding -inf/NaN/+inf validation certificate. This allows score/text replay; do not silently save only kept-query logits, cast to FP16, omit special/active positions, or truncate for the estimated storage budget.

A gain with the requested noun is evidence that supplied category conditioning helps this pipeline, not proof that all V81 errors were detector-caused. Correct target boxes may still lead box-only SAM to segment an occluder. Same-class ambiguity and target-instance association remain unproven.
